buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC CLAUSES 1. Scope of Supply. The bidder shall supply Car Cover, Blanket Cover, Blanket, Trekking Pole and Rechargeable Torch as per the specifications, quantities and delivery schedule mentioned in the bid. 2. Eligibility of Bidder. The bidder must be a registered firm/company/proprietorship or other legally recogn ised business entity eligible to participate in the tender as per applicable Government procurement rules. 3. Documents Required for Bid Submission. The bidder shall upload the following documents, as applicable : Valid GST Registration Certificate. PAN Card of the firm/proprietor/company. Udyam Registration Certifica te or MSME certificate, if applicable. Firm registration certificate or Certificate of Incorporation, wherever a pplicable. Bank details along with a cancelled cheque or bank certificate. Declaration regarding acceptanc e of all ATC terms and conditions. 4. Technical Specifications. The offered items must conform to the techn ical specifications, dimensions, material, quality and performance requirements specified in the bid. Any d eviation shall be clearly indicated by the bidder. 5. Product Catalogue and Technical Details. The bidder sh all upload product catalogues, brochures, technical datasheets or clear product photographs for all offered

items, wherever required, to establish compliance with the prescribed specifications. 6. Quality Requireme nts. All items supplied shall be new, unused, free from manufacturing defects and suitable for the intended purpose. Refurbished, used or damaged items shall not be accepted 8. Samples and Demonstration. The p urchaser reserves the right to request samples, product demonstrations or additional technical details fro m the bidder, where permitted by the applicable procurement rules and specified in the bid. Evaluation sh all be carried out on uniform and transparent criteria. 9. Experience and Past Performance. The bidder may be required to submit purchase orders, work orders or satisfactory performance certificates for similar sup plies, if prescribed in the bid. Any experience requirement shall be reasonable and consistent with applica ble procurement rules. 10. Delivery Period and Location. The successful bidder shall deliver all items to th e consignee/location specified in the bid within the stipulated delivery period. Transportation, packing, loa ding and other applicable delivery costs shall be included in the quoted price unless the bid specifies other wise. 11. Price and Taxes. The quoted price shall include all applicable costs, duties, taxes, packing, forwar ding and transportation charges, as applicable. GST shall be indicated in accordance with the bid requirem ents and applicable law. No additional charges shall be payable unless specifically permitted under the con tract. 12. Warranty and After-Sales Support. The supplier shall provide the applicable manufacturer's warr anty for items covered by warranty, particularly the rechargeable torch and its rechargeable battery, wher e applicable. Warranty duration and coverage shall be specified in the bid. The supplier shall replace or re pair defective items in accordance with the contract terms. 2 13. Inspection and Acceptance. All supplies s hall be subject to inspection by the authorised representative of the purchaser. Items that fail to meet the specified technical requirements or are found damaged or defective may be rejected and shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost, within the period stipulated by the purchaser. 14. Payment, Statutory Compliance and Contract Conditions. Payment shall be made after satisfactory delivery, inspection and ac ceptance of the supplies and submission of the prescribed invoice and supporting documents, in accordanc e with the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and payment rules. The bidder shall comply with all applicable statutory requirement and procurement instruction. 15. Declaration and Right of the Purchas er. The bidder shall declare that the information and documents submitted are true and valid. Submission of a bid shall constitute acceptance of the applicable tender conditions. The purchaser reserves the right to take action against false declarations, non-compliance or contractual default in accordance with the applic able procurement rules. The bid shall be processed, evaluated and awarded in accordance with the applic able GeM terms and Government procurement instructions. .
